topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The doorbell rings, and there on the doorstep are these beautifully arranged flowers, a vibrant mix of roses and lilies. I trace my fingers gently over the petals, wondering where they came from and who thought of me. No card, no note, just a silent bundle of color and scent. I breathe in deeply, the fragrance filling my lungs, bringing a warmth I hadn’t expected. Setting them on the table, I study the arrangement, each stem carefully placed, a thoughtful gesture from an unknown admirer or perhaps a friend. I can’t help but smile, feeling a sudden lightness, as if the room itself has brightened.
